description: Use this when the user asks what one of their status pages shows, which sites and checks are on it, or why its custom domain is not working. Returns the page with its components in order (with the ids the component tools take), its public URL, its subscriber count, and its custom domain's DNS record, verification and certificate state. Not for incidents posted on it: use list_incidents.
name: get_status_page
title: Get one status page
